decisions.reason: As a low-risk improvement to the core infrared portfolio, it likely stays because its strategic fit is high and only a clear sales shortfall versus aspiration would justify dropping it.
Its own product page suggests meaningful commitment, and in a growing market for efficient heating the firm is likely to retain this established-line extension unless results disappoint clearly.
Because it was only lightly presented and may be a more niche variant, management would be more willing to reallocate resources if its performance remains below aspiration.
A multi-model tube-heater line signals stronger organizational commitment and customer coverage, so the firm is likely to keep it absent strong evidence of underperformance.
Even if somewhat overlapping, a standard plaque-heater offer fits the firm's narrow core range and can be retained while demand remains uncertain and slack is not obviously strained.
Given its overlap with the broader tube-heater line and weaker visible commitment, it is the kind of product the firm would prune if returns fall short of aspiration.
